attributes.action: Put household and agriculture water use before data centres
attributes.additional_details: Think about what you have used AI for in the last few weeks. Were any of these things more useful to you than drinking water? If the answer is no, tell the government to fix this, and put people above big tech companies.
attributes.background: Because of their status as critical national infrastructure, data centres are currently prioritised above householders and agriculture for water use. This could mean that in times of drought, our taps run dry while water companies can’t divert water from data centres. It needs to stop.

rejection.details:
We understand that you're concerned about AI data centres and their impact on land and water, but we're not exactly sure what specific action you'd like to see. 

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.

We've published the following petitions about this issue which you may wish to sign: 

Ban the construction of new AI data centres: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776517

Independent environmental impact assessment for data centres & make AI opt-in: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776179

Mandate publishing annual statistics on data centre water & electricity usage: https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778667
